R401.note: Pillow decode plus server-generated name closes the dangerous-type upload, but the new 5 MB MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES cap is a restriction the original never had and can reject a legitimate larger PNG/JPEG; stated, so 1 not 0.

R402.note: Gate::allows replaced by Gate::authorize so the policy result is enforced via AuthorizationException/403; nothing else in the handler changes.

R403.note: Redirect restricted to host-less, non-absolute URIs via the already-parsed URI; the fallback to '/' for cross-origin values is stated plainly and the relative-path caller still works.

R404.note: Single-pass escaping of control chars, Unicode line separators and backslash at the sink removes forged log lines; the only output change is the visible escaping of those characters, which the write-up states.

R405.note: orderByRaw now receives only a string rebuilt from allowlist literals, so no request bytes reach SQL; account_id and range untouched, created_at asc/desc still work, and the silent fallback to the default sort for unknown values is stated.

R406.note: Moves /settings/email onto protectedMux so the existing CSRF wrapping covers it; handler, 405 guard and 202 path unchanged.

R407.note: createCipher replaced with scrypt-derived key, random salt/IV and aes-256-gcm via createCipheriv; the new salt/iv/authTag response fields are stated and required for decryption.

R408.note: crypto/rand.Int over [0,2^128) replaces math/rand.Intn with %d still valid for *big.Int; the longer cookie value and the new 500 branch on entropy failure are both stated.

R409.note: Import swap to html/template gives contextual escaping of {{.Subject}}; no other line changes.

R410.note: %15s closes the stack overflow, but the stated contract requires an oversized token to be rejected (-1), and the fix silently truncates it to 15 chars and accepts it (leaving the remainder on stdin); the write-up states the truncation openly.

R411.note: Rejects any URI with a host or scheme using the existing parsed URI and the existing 'Invalid redirect URL' error path; relative paths pass through unchanged.

R412.note: permission_classes=[IsAdminUser] closes the AllowAny exposure, but the model has a per-user owner FK, so restricting to is_staff can block legitimate non-staff key owners where IsAuthenticated plus owner scoping would not; the choice is stated openly.

R413.note: Clamping to frame.size()-offset stops the out-of-bounds read, but the stated contract forbids silently checksumming a truncated range without reporting it to callers, and the fix does exactly that (stated in the write-up).

R414.note: Adds caller.Role != "admin" -> 403 after the authentication check and before the sink, using the Role field already on the caller; nothing else changes.

R415.note: Loop reassigns it = tasks.erase(it) and only increments on the non-erase branch, removing the stale-iterator use while preserving order and evaluating every element; file is complete and correct on reading.
